title: Fishy Hub | Full Egg Auto Farm, Auto Rebirth, Auto Buy +More
features:
The automation provides a graphical interface built with the custom Liquid Glass library for and by Fishy Hub. It includes an auto egg farm feature that handles egg purchasing and hatching repeatedly. A animal equipping function automatically selects and equips the best available animal. The script offers auto ride functionality that mounts and rides animals without manual input. An auto sell feature manages inventory by selling unwanted pets for currency. The UI includes toggle controls and configuration options for enabling or disabling each automation module. Theme customization through the ThemeManager addon lets users personalize the interface appearance.

Ride a Pet, Ride a Pet!
